reason: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35, PollFeed unconditionally calls CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) on each SimpleRSS item, which raises NoMethodError on nil for RSS 2.0 items with only <description> or <content:encoded> (exposed by SimpleRSS as content_encoded). With sidekiq_options retry: false at app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:12 and no per-item rescue in the loop at app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:31-37, this aborts the entire feed poll.
